#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib

CHECK_FN = "CHECK_FN"
OFFSET = "OFFSET"
PATCH_BYTE = "PATCH_BYTE"

def derive(seed: bytes) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(seed).hexdigest()
    body = digest[:8]
    checksum = 0
    for index in range(0, 8, 2):
        checksum ^= int(body[index:index + 2], 16)
    serial = "KS-{}-{:02x}".format(body, checksum)
    return serial

print(derive(b"workspace-fixture"))
print("CHECK_FN", CHECK_FN)
print("OFFSET", OFFSET)
print("PATCH_BYTE", PATCH_BYTE)
